name: input-otp
title: One-time code
description: Takes a code received by text message or email: one box per digit, in groups, a single field for screen readers, paste and the code the system suggests.

fr.description: Permet de remplir un code reçu par SMS ou e-mail : une case par chiffre, en groupes, un seul champ pour le lecteur d'écran, le collage et le code proposé par le système.

changelog: A code that becomes invalid shakes once (`FlShake`), on top of its `danger` outline. New `success`: a `success` outline is drawn around each box, one after the other (`medium2` each, `short1` apart), at once under reduced motion. Resting rendering unchanged; adding `success` breaks nothing.
